sections.title: New Mexico corporate income and franchise taxes

rows.label: Corporate income tax rate
rows.note: Flat rate on all New Mexico taxable income; the former 4.8% bracket ended after 2024. From the 2025 CIT-1 instructions, the latest published; no change announced for 2026.

sections.title: New Mexico property tax: state rules

rows.label: Levied by
rows.value: Counties, municipalities, school districts, special districts, institutions of higher education, plus a state debt service levy
rows.note: Rates are certified each year by the Department of Finance and Administration, Local Government Division.

source.title: New Mexico Department of Finance and Administration: Overview of Property Tax Certification Process, effective July 28, 2026

rows.label: State oversight
rows.value: New Mexico Taxation and Revenue Department, Property Tax Division
rows.note: Monitors county assessors and values state-assessed property; DFA Local Government Division certifies tax rates.

source.title: New Mexico Taxation and Revenue Department: Property Tax Overview

rows.label: Constitutional limit on operating rates
rows.value: 20 mills ($20 per $1,000 of net taxable value): counties up to $11.85, municipalities up to $7.65, school districts up to $0.50
rows.note: Limit on general operating levies without voter approval; voter-approved and debt levies are on top.

sections.title: New Mexico real estate transfer tax: figures under review

rows.label: State real estate transfer tax
rows.value: None: New Mexico has no real estate transfer tax
rows.note: Bills to create one (e.g. a 2021 Real Estate Transfer Tax Act proposal) were introduced; no current official statement could be read.
